Reviewed the new compose_test.ts against 9b8bffb. ensure and teardown each run through createModelTestContext with a stub exec at __setExec that hands out the answers its test lists in order and rejects any call past them, restored in a finally. ensure: a success test that starts only the service not ready (asserts the up argv) and writes the state record with each service's status, and a failure test where up exits 1, asserting the message and no record. teardown: a success test asserting down --remove-orphans --volumes and an empty state record, and a failure test with no record. argv building, ps parsing in both shapes and readiness keep pure tests. No credential is taken. deno task test: 7 passed. The new README Tests section matches the file.
